MWCC 2.4.2 roots a switch binary-search tree at the median case value and emits a bare branch with no compare for a case whose body is empty. A retail pivot that sits below the lowest visible case therefore identifies a hidden empty case; this is how fn_800238BC's case -1 was recovered.
